metadata.name: Hazakura Editor

metadata.promotional_text: A calmer place to write in Markdown, read your draft like a book, and export to EPUB or PDF. Review changes before you keep them.
metadata.description:
Write in Markdown. Read like a book. Make the next draft your own.

Hazakura Editor is a calm writing space for Mac, built around your Markdown and text files. Move from drafting to book-like reading, review your changes, and export when your work is ready.

WRITE WITH FOCUS
Edit Markdown directly or use L Mode for a quieter, single-pane writing experience. Keep your files in folders you choose, use multiple tabs, and move through your document with an outline and search.

READ THE BIG PICTURE
Read your work in an ebook-style view with a two-page spread. Bring selected Markdown chapters together in a Book Scope to read and export them as a book.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU KEEP
Compare changes, handle save conflicts, and review available backup snapshots before applying them. Your Markdown remains the source of truth. Choose which changes to apply and when to save.

EXPORT YOUR WORK
Export a document or selected book chapters to EPUB or PDF. Export the current Markdown document as standalone HTML. Add a cover to your EPUB when you need one.

REFINE ON YOUR MAC
On supported systems, Hazakura Local Assist offers on-device writing suggestions. Review a proposal before applying it to your document, then save when you decide. Local Assist does not send your writing to a cloud AI service or fall back to cloud AI.

A LITTLE MORE PERSONAL
Choose light, dark, or seasonal themes, and adjust the text size for writing and reading.

REQUIREMENTS AND IMPORTANT DETAILS
Requires macOS 26.0 or later. Local Assist is a preview feature that depends on your Mac, macOS version, supported language and region, and system settings. Writing, reading, and export do not require Local Assist.

Remote images are disabled by default. Loading remote images or opening external links may use a network connection.
metadata.whats_new: This update improves editor scrolling when the preview is open, including dragging to the bottom of a document and keeping your position after releasing the scrollbar. It also fixes skipped matches when replacing text and prevents editing through replacement and L Mode controls while Local Assist is generating a proposal.
